summary: Cashier with two years of part-time experience in a busy neighborhood supermarket. My drawer has balanced at close on every shift this year, I know the self-checkout and returns desk, and I stay calm with long lines. Available evenings and weekends, including holidays.

experiences.description: Neighborhood supermarket with eight registers and four self-checkout stations. 20 to 25 hours a week.

achievements.text: Ring up about 70 customers an hour during the Saturday rush with cash, card, mobile pay and SNAP EBT
Drawer balanced at close on every shift in 2026; trusted to do the evening cash pickup and safe drop
Cover the self-checkout area two evenings a week: clear alerts, check ID for age-restricted items and help with produce codes
Showed four new cashiers the register, coupon rules and opening checklist during their first week
Signed up about 150 customers for the store loyalty card in one quarter, the most on the evening team
Worked the register and gift-wrap counter through the holiday season, including Black Friday weekend
Restocked shelves from the back room each morning and kept the front displays tidy
Asked back for the spring break season because of attendance and customer feedback

education.description: Evening classes in accounting basics and customer relations.

volunteering.description: Check in families and pack grocery boxes one Saturday a month.

skills.title: Register
skills.description: Cash handling, card and mobile payments, EBT, returns and exchanges, voids and price overrides, self-checkout support

skills.title: Store
skills.description: Bagging, shelf restocking, price checks, opening and closing checklists, age verification

skills.title: Customers
skills.description: Friendly service, handling complaints, loyalty card sign-ups, bilingual help in Spanish
